configurePresets.name: msvc-x64
configurePresets.description: Needs CMake 4.2+ (lists 'Visual Studio 18 2026' in 'cmake --help'). If configure fails, use msvc-x64-vs2022 or upgrade CMake from cmake.org.

configurePresets.name: msvc-x64-vs2022
configurePresets.description: Use when your cmake --help does not list 'Visual Studio 18 2026'. Works with CMake 3.24+ and a VS install that CMake can detect (often VS 2022 Build Tools; may not match a VS-only-2026 layout).
